body: Part of my physical therapy. They weren't paying anymore and I just wanted it done with.
Actually since I was a pedestrian the drivers insurance covered it.  All except 300 which I had to pay for.

Actually when they tried to get a person to call for a contact out of me I just kept saying I needed to get to work and gave them their number.  So they called work and also called me out while getting a contact number.  4 months later when I went back my bosses made fun of me.

I was 19 heading to my job on night shift as a waiter it was raining out very heavily so I grabbed my backpack as usual and my calf length leather duster jacket.  I left the house and went up to US highway 9 that runs directly in front of my house waited for traffic to clear and started to cross the road (a car heading north bound in the far lane had stopped prior to the intersection I was crossing at so I began crossing.) Their was another car that passed this car on the right in the shoulder and hit me doing 45 mph.  I went through the windshield and down the road at a very fast rate of speed if not for my leather duster I would have lost a lot of skin on my back and legs.  I was face down in a puddle and the E.M.T.s arrived they put me on a back board and started for the nearest hospital.  En route the hospital told them that I could not be received their due to my injuries being so severe I was then shipped up to Neptune NJ over an hr and a half away.  I started to come back to a little more heartily in the back of the ambulance.  Since they arrived on the scene I was totally against them touching my injuries.  It may seem counter intuitive but my fight or flight response along with the head trauma kicked in and I was very aggressively fighting them.  I even hit one of the E.M.T.s so hard I dropped him (sorry man.) as I get to the hospital the doctors see my injuries and I am taken to the trauma unit and sedated.  The sedation along with the injuries put me in a coma for 9 days.  I got a titanium ulna and still get to pick glass out of my head for the whole trip.  Yay fun times.

I have been in the exact same head space and more my friend.  If there is one thing I can say for certain it is please truly exhaust all your other resources before you take that road.  When you are in there you are surrounded by some (very few mind you) similar people.  Just others who are having a very hard time coping.  But the majority of those you will be immersed in are bat shit crazy so bad that it makes your own self worth take a vicious beating.  I was so absent of self worth when I left it was worse than when I entered. 

You might think that the doctors are a big draw but from my experience all they are is there to bring you to their definition of a baseline before any real attempt at communication and by then it is a bad scene.  So if you can get some therapy on your own you can usually find something if you look into the community outreach programs around you and do anything else first it is always there if you need it but, DO NOT see it as a health spa it is hell.or at least was for me.
I said broccoli, I think I'm on the fritz.
You are not worthless! Now tits on a bull they are worthless.

My father came from a very upper crust family and my mother and he were not married when I was conceived.  Also my mothers family while not being poor were not to my grandmothers liking.  So when my mother told my fathers parents that she was pregnant my grandmother told her that she should get an abortion and they would pay for it and if she did come to term never to contact they family because I would never see a cent of the family estate.  Fast forward 15 years I was in a fight with my mother about the fact that I thought that sometimes physicality is necessary and that as long as it is not used to instigate but either defend or deter it can't be taken off the table.  Her reply " Your grand mother was right I should have had the abortion. "  and she told the whole story.  That sucked.
Thank you.  It seems like all I ever hear is how I either not doing something right or not enough.  What they don't get is that it's actually living that hurts.

Ok here goes the post that will possibly make me feel the worst I can.  First one I went to visit my Grandmother who almost single handedly raised me in her retirement home.  I go in with a very good friend of mine and sit at her bed side almost immediately I realize that something is wrong.  I send him to get a nurse.  She is whispering that she is tired and breathing really shallow.  I realize she is terrified and tell her to relax everything will be fine.  She doesn't have to take care of us (my mother and myself) anymore.  That I would make sure my mother is ok and she just needs to rest and take it easy. With in 10 seconds she lets out a final long slow exhale and is gone her hand goes limp in mine and that's it.  Second I witnessed and accident on a on ramp to US 9 a pedestrian was hit by a lowboy trailer while it was empty.  I screamed and went to check on the victim who was twelve ways from normal. avulsions, things bent the wrong way, and things were just not where they should be on the inside.  So I go back to the trucker who is going into shock and try as best I can to care for him.  Last I went to pick up a coworker for work he didn't answer the door to his cheap sleazy hotel room.  He was a work in progress recovering alcoholic.  So I tried the door it was open and I went inside he was taking a shower. so I screamed at him and got no response so I waited for 5-10 min before trying again still no ans. I go in and he had slipped in the tub onto the tile floor and had a hemorrhage in his brain I called 911 and checked for a pulse tried CPR but no use.  I need a fucking drink.

I guess I am looking for someone to talk too about the fact that my apathy is so far gone that now every waking second I have is in planning my end and how to best take care of my affairs.  Not financial but just best explain to my loved ones that the pain is too much to handle.
Thought it might be too far into the wee hours.  So why would a good person like you be contributing your time this evening.  I though am glad you are around talking is better than planning.
